mentions.name: InstaVM
mentions.description: This platform provides sandboxes for AI agents through a CLI, with built-in guardrails including egress control, secret injection, and audit trails. It positions itself as 'AWS for AI agents' and can be used as third-party sandboxes in Anthropic managed agents and the OpenAI SDK.
mentions.source_excerpt:
AWS for AI agents - https://instavm.io

Providing sandboxes through a CLI. Guardrails such as egress control and secret injection and audit trails built in.

We can also be used as 3rd party sandboxes in Anthropic managed agent and OpenAI sdk.
